quest.title: Wine, with a Taste of Freedom
quest.description: Business is slow in Degui's tavern lately, and he doesn't know what to do...

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: Business seems to be grinding to a halt...

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: I was just saying, business is getting tougher and tougher in this tavern of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: For us in the food and drink business, having a long history is both a blessing and a curse.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: The good part is, a long history gives you more of a reputation, which helps bring in business.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: The bad part is, people get bored of having the same thing over and over again. In big restaurants, where they have plenty of variety, that's obviously not a problem.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: But my tavern is only a small one.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: My long-term regulars are now finally starting to get bored with the drinks, and one by one they're leaving...

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: I've heard there's a big wine industry in Mondstadt. They have a famous Dandelion Wine, supposedly brewed with Dandelions.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: I'm not even sure if brewing with Dandelions is possible... But I'd like to at least give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: Could you go to Mondstadt and fetch some Dandelions for me?

response.speaker: Degui
response.text: Great. You have my word I will pay you for your trouble. And in Liyue, our word is our bond.

response.speaker: Degui
response.text: You think it's a strange flavor? That may be, but I've heard it's extremely popular in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Degui
response.text: Although, it's not going to sell if I just copy the exact same recipe...

response.speaker: Degui
response.text: Anyway, start by bringing me some <color=#00E1FFFF>Dandelions</color>, and in the meantime, I will think about how to add a little Liyue touch to the brewing process.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: I will experiment a bit to start with, and see if I can add Dandelions in to a Liyue-style brewing process.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: Oh, and this is for you.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: I'm not expecting to get this right the first time. It will probably take me many attempts. If I run out of Dandelions, I may have to ask you to do another run for me.
